# Sue's Angels FC

> Sue's Angels FC is a men's Sunday-league football club based in Kingston upon Thames, South West London. Founded in 2025 in memory of Susan Anne Martin, the club plays to raise awareness of sepsis. In its first season the team were crowned champions of League Ten in the Southern Sunday Football League and won promotion to League Eight.

## Key facts
- Name: Sue's Angels FC
- Location: Kingston upon Thames / Hanworth, South West London, United Kingdom
- Home ground: The Reeves, Hanworth
- League: Southern Sunday Football League (currently League Eight; League Ten champions in their 2025/26 debut season)
- Founded: 2025, in memory of Susan Anne Martin
- Cause: raising awareness of sepsis
- Website: https://www.suesangelsfc.co.uk
